verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI offers several levers that trade speed against completeness. Dynamic crawling can wait for async or sync content (gh-21), and full-page scrolling captures infinite-scroll content (gh-25). Adaptive crawling stops once enough information is gathered (docs-3), max-pages bounds deep crawls (gh-2), and prefetch mode speeds up URL discovery (gh-31). However, the evidence never shows fine-grained control over exactly when content is returned. Missing for 10: documented wait-condition or timeout parameters (e.g. wait-for selector or page-load event choices), streaming or partial-result return, and independent hands-on corroboration of these latency/completeness controls.
